fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: PriceUsd
fields.description: Price per month in USD; 0 for Free; absent/0 with ContactSales for a price agreed with sales.

fields.name: CreditUsd
fields.description: Credit in USD granted when the plan starts (each month for paid plans; the sign-up credit for Free).

fields.name: MaxParallelStreams
fields.description: Changes built side by side; 0 = custom (agreed with sales).

fields.name: FeaturesJson
fields.description: JSON array of plain feature lines.

fields.name: ContactSales
fields.description: True: no list price, people contact sales.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: False: not offered any more (existing subscriptions keep it).

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.
